facts.element: library room group north of north stoa
facts.value: Row of rooms north, behind the upper storey of the north stoa of the Athena sanctuary: one large hall at the east end, and to its west a group of three rooms; a small court with a separate room group (so-called art collection) lies west at stoa ground-floor level. Identification as the royal library (Bohn, Hoepfner) is disputed (Mielsch, Strocka).
facts.quote: am weitesten östlich ein großer Saal, westlich anschließend eine Dreiraumgruppe.
facts.note: DAI iDAI.objects record; cites Bohn AvP II 60 f. Taf. XXXIII-XXXV. Laufer 2020 (in same record) would exclude the large hall from library use (banquet hall).

facts.value: Reading hall 16.7 m long x 10.9 m deep (about 178 m2); facade 21 m long, over 16 m high; shelf niches 2.6 m high, over 1 m wide
facts.quote: Dieser hat mit 10,9 m Tiefe und 16,7 m Länge eine Größe von rund 178 Quadratmetern.
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://de.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Celsus-Bibliothek&action=raw' | rg -o -m1 '10,9 m Tiefe und 16,7 m Länge.{0,50}'
facts.note: Wikipedia cites Wilberg in FiE V 1 (1953) and Hueber/Strocka. Primary FiE V 1 is open at https://digi.ub.uni-heidelberg.de/diglit/fie_bd5_1 (ch. I, Das Gebäude, pp. 1-42); the figures were not read there.

books.note: Suda On Line, kappa 227 (live stoa.org unreachable, Wayback copy used). The Suda gives the title; it does not itself say the work catalogued the Library.

books.title: Books bought with Celsus's 25,000-denarii legacy (no title attested)
books.why: Aquila's will left 25,000 denarii for the library; interest was to pay repairs, decoration, staff and book purchases. No book title is attested in the inscription commentary read.
books.quote: Aquila hatte wohl, als er in seinem Testament den Betrag von 25.000 Denaren für die Bibliothek aussetzte
books.note: Keil, FiE V 1 (1953) p. 76, commentary on inscription Nr. 13 (IvE 5113 in later numbering, not checked here). Keil infers book purchase ('Ankauf von Büchern') from the interest budget. Pages 0076-0088 skimmed for titles; none found. Reconstructed Greek/Latin text lines on 0085-0087 not read line by line.
